import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { UserIcon, MapPinIcon, PhoneIcon, EnvelopeIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline'; const Profile = () => { const { user } = useAuth(); const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { if (user) { loadUserOrders(); } }, [user]); const loadUserOrders = () => { const allOrders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('farm2home_orders') || '[]'); const userOrders = allOrders.filter(order => order.customerId === user.id); setOrders(userOrders.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt))); setLoading(false); }; if (!user) { return ; } if (loading) { return (

Loading profile...

); } return (
{/* Profile Header */}
{user.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').toUpperCase()}

{user.name}

{user.userType}
{user.email}
{user.phone}
{user.address}
{/* Stats Cards for Customers */} {user.userType === 'customer' && (
📦

Total Orders

{orders.length}

💰

Total Spent

₹{orders.reduce((total, order) => total + order.total, 0)}

🥬

Items Purchased

{orders.reduce((total, order) => total + order.items.reduce((itemTotal, item) => itemTotal + item.quantity, 0), 0 )}

)} {/* Order History */}

{user.userType === 'customer' ? 'Order History' : 'Recent Orders'}

{orders.length === 0 ? (
📦

No orders yet

{user.userType === 'customer' ? 'Start shopping to see your orders here' : 'Orders will appear here when customers purchase your vegetables' }

) : (
{orders.map(order => (

Order #{order.id.toString().slice(-6)}

{new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}

₹{order.total}

{order.status}
{order.items.map((item, index) => (

{item.name}

by {item.farmer.name}

{item.quantity}kg × ₹{item.price}

₹{item.quantity * item.price}

))}
Delivery Address: {order.customerAddress}
))}
)}
{/* Account Information */}

Account Information

{user.name}

{user.email}

{user.phone}

{user.userType}

{user.address}

); }; export default Profile;
